Keybindings.ToggleHudName: Show or hide the combat HUD
Keybindings.ToggleHudHint: Shows or hides the entire Smoother Fight HUD while combat is running.
Keybindings.CollapseCombatActionsHint: Collapses all open attack, spell, and defense actions in the combat HUD.
Keybindings.OpenLatestCombatActionHint: Opens only the latest combat action and brings it into view.

Settings.EnabledHint: Automatically shows the Smoother Fight HUD while a combat is running.
Settings.HideSystemBarName: Hide Splittermond action bar during combat
Settings.HideSystemBarHint: Hides the normal bottom action bar only while this combat HUD is visible.
Settings.ShowCardsHint: Shows recent attack, defense, and damage cards belonging to the combat directly in the HUD.
Settings.MaxCardsHint: How many recent attacks and their associated damage to offer in the HUD.
Settings.DefenseRecalculationHint: Creates a new attack card using the increased defense after a successful active defense.
Settings.LinksMenuHint: Links character/NPC sheets and individual tokens to their users.
Settings.LinksTitle: Smoother Fight – users, sheets, and tokens
Settings.LinksHint: Sheet assignments automatically apply to every token created from that sheet. Direct token assignments are exceptions and take priority.
Settings.PrimaryGmHint: Tokens without an explicit assignment automatically use this GM's target selection.
Settings.SheetAssignmentsHint: This assignment persists when a token is deleted and later recreated from the same sheet.
Settings.NoSheets: No character or NPC sheets were found.
Settings.TokenAssignmentsHint: Each token can be directly assigned to at most one user. Teal entries are inherited from the sheet; italic gray entries from the primary GM.
Settings.NoTokens: No tokens were found on the current scene.
Settings.TokenAssignHint: Set a direct exception for {token}. It takes priority over sheet and primary-GM assignments.
Settings.TokenAssignmentCleared: The direct assignment for {token} was removed; sheet and fallback rules apply again.

HUD.NoTargetDetail: Target with T or use the target menu.
HUD.NoOwner: Only owners of this token can use its actions.
HUD.GmOnly: Only the GM may use this action.
HUD.NoCombatants: No other combat tokens are present on the scene.
HUD.NoEvents: No attack, spell, fumble, or damage card has been created in this combat yet.
HUD.FumbleNotAllowed: You do not own the affected character.
HUD.DamageTargetMissing: The target stored for this attack is no longer available.
HUD.ActionFailed: The action could not be completed. See the console for details.
HUD.DefenseNotAllowed: You do not own the selected target.
HUD.LinkedUserOffline: The assigned player is offline. The last known target is used.
